name: Literature
about: A prior work that bears on the contribution claim, or a citation to verify

---

**Work**
Authors, title, venue, year, DOI or URL.

**Verification level**
Located / abstract read / full text read.

**Why it matters here**
Which claim in `PROPOSAL.md` or `docs/08-literature.md` it supports, narrows, or
contradicts. Be specific: this project has already narrowed its contribution once
on exactly this basis, and will do so again if warranted.
